exposure.needed: whether Pod restart events are emitted and consumed in the environment

consequence.statement: Consumers of these Kubernetes events (e.g. tooling or automation matching on the `regardingObject`/`related` fields) will see the new layout, with the Kafka resource in `regardingObject` and the Pod in `related`; the events are still emitted, only structured differently.
consequence.remediation: Review any automation that consumes Pod-restart Kubernetes events and update it to the new `regardingObject`/`related` field usage.

assertion.statement: In Strimzi 0.46.0, Kubernetes events emitted during a Pod restart now carry the Kafka resource as the `regardingObject` and the Pod in the `related` field, changing the field layout of these events.
